- Company holidays do not reduce the PTO bank. If a holiday falls inside an approved PTO period, only scheduled working hours on non-holiday days are deducted. - Two floating holidays are available under MF-POL-102 for eligible regular full-time employees. Floating holidays are requested through the ordinary time-off workflow and are not fixed calendar dates. [MF-CAL-2026 §Floating holidays]
- A company holiday that falls during an approved PTO period does not use PTO hours. Only hours that the employee otherwise would have worked are charged. An employee with a non-standard workweek should use the schedule actually assigned for that week. [MF-POL-102 §3. Holiday during PTO]
